consumables/loam_bread.name: Loam Bread
consumables/loam_bread.description: Dense composting-city fare from Loamgate. Restores a little vigor.
consumables/loam_bread.flavour: Everything returns. Some of it returns as bread.

materials/cinder_ink_vial.name: Cinder-Ink Vial
materials/cinder_ink_vial.description: Ash-Bound tattoo ink; names written in it resist the Waning's slow erasure.
materials/cinder_ink_vial.flavour: The soul is a held line. Hold it.

relics/captured_reflection.name: Captured Reflection
relics/captured_reflection.description: An obsidian shard that shows a room lit by a sky that does not exist.
relics/captured_reflection.flavour: Do not name what you see in it. Under the Vow, a named Seat must abdicate.

relics/quine_shard.name: QUINE Shard
relics/quine_shard.description: A fragment of pre-Bloom machine, one cyan light still faintly alive.
relics/quine_shard.flavour: It is still counting. No one knows what.

tools/soul_gauge.name: Soul Gauge
tools/soul_gauge.description: A brass-and-glass dial that reads a soul's integrity — and what magic has spent.
tools/soul_gauge.flavour: The needle is honest. That is the problem.

weapons/taubstummer_axe.name: Taubstummer Axe
weapons/taubstummer_axe.description: A sealed soul-weapon of the Last Great War; its edge remembers what it unmade.
weapons/taubstummer_axe.flavour: It does not ring when struck. Nothing it touches does.
